id.description: Stable, lowercase, used by a card's lane tag.

name.description: The name on the bay's plate. Short enough for a plate at minimum zoom.

purpose.description: What happens in this lane, for screen readers and the legend.

keywords.description: Whole words (or word runs) in a card's discipline that place it here. Matched on word boundaries, never inside a word.

paths.description: Repository paths that place work here: a directory prefix ("apps/web/"), an exact path, or a glob (`*` within a segment, `**` across segments).

description:
One work lane: one work bay on the Plant. Its position in its set is its bay (the first lane is the
first slot of WorkBaySlot, and so on). Not a data lane (DataLane), which classifies information.
